resolved.title: 列表操作
resolved.description:
[s0l0!-header][h1]List Operations [/h1][/s0l0!-header] 

The list of cool things we can do with lists just keeps growing!
Lists can also be added and multiplied in the same way as strings.

[s0l0!-header][b]For example:[/b][/s0l0!-header][code format="py" codeId="3919"]nums = [1, 2, 3]
print(nums + [4, 5, 6])
print(nums * 3)[/code]
Lists and strings share a lot of similarities - you can basically think of strings as lists of characters that can't be changed.
[note]The string "Hello" can be thought of as a list, where each character is an item in the list. The first item is "H", the second item is "e", and so on.[/note]

resolved.title: 输出姓名简写
resolved.problem_statement_md:
请写一个程序，将一个姓名作为输入，输出姓和名的首字母作为简写。

为了方便读写，请在字母后面加一个 `.`。
resolved.problem_statement_en_md:
[s0l0!-header][h1]Strings as Lists[/h1][/s0l0!-header] 

You need to take the first and last name of a person as input and output the initials (first letters of the first and last name).

[b]Sample Input[/b]
James
Smith

[b]Sample Output [/b]
J.S. 

[note]In order to match the output, you need to place dots after each initial.[/note]

code_templates.template:
fname = input()
lname = input()
#your code goes here
code_templates.solution_code:
fname = input()
lname = input()
print (fname[0]+'.' + lname[0] + '.')
